Subject: Follow-up: Novapulse discovery + reschedule for exec demo

Hi Ami —

Thanks again for taking time today. I know the calendar jam meant we weren’t able to get Emily on the call, so I wanted to: 1) capture the short discovery notes, 2) propose a tight set of options for an executive demo (20–30m) with our solutions architect, and 3) make sure we lock something that works for Emily.

Quick recap from our end:
- Primary goals: reduce inference latency for batch scoring, cut inference cost per 1M tokens by ~30% over current infra, and tighten SLA for peak traffic windows.
- Must-haves: private VPC deployment option and audit logs for compliance.
- Interested parties: Engineering (Emily, decision), Ops (Ami), Security TBD.

Proposed exec demo (we can keep this 25m + 5m buffer):
1) Fri Oct 7 — 09:00–09:30 PT
2) Sat Oct 8 — 11:00–11:30 PT
3) Mon Oct 9 — 08:00–08:30 PT

Because Emily’s calendar is tight, can you please confirm one of the three by end of day tomorrow (Oct 2) so we can reserve the engineer and generate a calendar invite? If we don’t hear back within 24 hours I’ll assume you’d prefer we release the reserved slot and I’ll open a new set of options.

Attachments: discovery-notes-20261001.txt (brief notes), MAP-v1.pdf (high-level mutual action plan) — both attached.

If none of the above work, tell me two windows Emily does have and I’ll try to compress the team schedule to fit.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

— Evelyn

If you can make 8:45–9:15 on Oct 9 work, please lock it — we’ll prioritize that. If not, Tue Oct 12 after 2pm PT is our fallback.
